standard_prerequisites.name: Open subschemes of schemes
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Properties of Spaces, lemma subscheme (cross-chapter, named)

core_obligations: (alpha): a finite affine open cover of U factoring through the X_i gives finitely many finite fibres.
(beta): monomorphisms compose with the open immersions X_i -> X.
(gamma): reduces to the two cases above via the condition graph.
(delta): the covering families U_{ij} -> X_i composed with X_i -> X cover X and keep universally bounded fibres.
(epsilon): the compositions are etale; U_{ij} x_{X_i} U_{ij} = U_{ij} x_X U_{ij} keeps the projections quasi-compact; the coproduct is surjective.
(zeta): Zariski-local quasi-separatedness is itself Zariski local (an open of an open is open).
(theta): delegated to the cross-chapter subscheme lemma.
proof_roadmap: Seven cases; the five explicit cases use covering transfer; zeta is a definition unfolding; theta is cited.
difficulty_reason: A locality statement proven case by case; the epsilon case with its four-lemma etale composition chain is the longest.
